summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expands the direct public-company universe for the education compliance/data/identity node. The strongest reference anchor is Pearson through Pearson VUE and OnVUE, while the underfollowed lane is more likely to include mid/small-cap education operators and infrastructure-adjacent firms whose filings expose dependence on regulated student data, online delivery, student-loan systems, payments, learning-management systems, and reporting workflows. This pass prioritizes direct exposure and evidence availability; several candidates are customers or platform operators rather than pure-play compliance vendors because many pure proctoring, SIS, accreditation, and identity vendors remain private. Layer 1B expands the universe around scarce or sticky suppliers for digital education compliance, identity, student records, payment, and data workflows. The strongest direct public-market mappings found in this pass are not pure online-learning names; they are education payments/SIS vendors, school data platforms, and identity-verification infrastructure providers. Most proctoring-specific vendors appear private, so the public-stock discovery lane leans toward adjacent identity, fraud, student-data, and institutional workflow companies. No buy/sell recommendation is made. Expanded the public universe around education compliance/data/identity infrastructure with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Pearson as a scaled testing/certification gatekeeper. Underfollowed lane: Nelnet for campus payment/student admin infrastructure, Coursera for credential identity/data controls, and Mitek
